title: Activity-gated event band (SIM §6.2)
simLoop: WorldState.stepEvent ran surface flow and fire every sim-minute even when the preserve was dry. The event band is now activity-gated: surfaceWater + fire run only when any surfaceDepth > 0, the armed storm window will discharge precip, or any cell is burning. Atmosphere always runs (cloud decay / dawn charge). simMinutes and slower bands always advance.
gameLoop: Storms still cost wall time; dry stretches between them no longer pay the full event-band bill. A century at ordinary storminess drops from tens of minutes of CPU toward single-digit minutes without changing any outcome the player can bet on — the gate is hash-identical to the ungated ladder.
notebookSeed: Between storms the water sheet is gone and the ground is just waiting — time still moves, but the rush is over.
tierO: no owner-only question — hash-identity is CI-judged; D-007 clip gate does not apply (no new Process). Next tip is L4 biotic motion (§4.39).
